definitions.identity: A native individual identity when the format provides one; otherwise the specified ROM-save, location and validated-record-digest key.
definitions.speciesForm: Canonical species identity plus form/alias normalization when the game stores a form.
definitions.level: Structurally validated level or level derived from validated experience and growth data.
definitions.gender: Decoded or derived gender where the generation implements Pokémon gender.
definitions.hpStatus: Current/max HP and status where meaningful for the decoded representation.
definitions.experience: Experience progress toward the next level.
definitions.nature: Nature identity where the generation implements natures.
definitions.ability: Ability identity where the generation implements abilities.
definitions.heldItem: Held-item identity or affirmative presence where the generation stores held items.
definitions.ivDv: Six IVs or the generation-appropriate five-value DV projection.
definitions.storageLocation: Player-facing Party slot or PC box and slot.
definitions.liveBoxes: PC records decoded from the existing live polling read plan, without another poller.
definitions.exactRecoveryBoxes: Checksum- and ROM-save-identity-validated SaveRAM recovery when live PC data is unavailable.
